mainEntity.name: What types of addiction does Wayside House of Hamilton treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wayside House of Hamilton provides treatment for a wide range of substance use disorders, including alcohol, opioids, stimulants, and other drugs. Our programs are tailored specifically for women and take a trauma-informed, holistic approach to recovery.

mainEntity.name: Is Wayside House only for women?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Wayside House of Hamilton is a women-only treatment facility. We offer gender-specific care in a safe, supportive environment designed to address the unique challenges women face during recovery.

mainEntity.name: What programs are offered at Wayside House of Hamilton?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer a comprehensive range of services including residential treatment, transitional housing, and continuing care. Our goal is to support every stage of recovery, from detox through to reintegration into the community.

mainEntity.name: How long is the residential treatment program?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of our residential treatment program can vary based on individual needs, but most programs typically run from 35 to 90 days. We work closely with each woman to develop a personalized treatment plan that supports lasting recovery.

mainEntity.name: How do I apply for treatment at Wayside House of Hamilton?

acceptedAnswer.text: To apply, visit our website and complete the online referral form, or contact our intake team directly. We also accept referrals from healthcare professionals, community agencies, and family members.

about_blocks.text: Wayside House of Hamilton is a trusted non-profit addiction treatment centre dedicated to helping women reclaim their lives through recovery. Located in the heart of Hamilton, Ontario, we specialize in gender-specific addiction treatment services designed to meet the unique needs of women battling substance use disorders.

about_blocks.text: With over 50 years of experience, our trauma-informed, client-centred programs include residential treatment, transitional housing, and continuing care, offering a holistic path to long-term recovery.
